rationale: BOS Civil is a direct Perth employer explicitly welcoming a "motivated Trainee Drainer" alongside ticketed drainers.

This is manual trade/labourer drainage work on site crews, not a civil engineering design or project role.
caution: This is a manual trade/labourer drainer role, not a civil engineering design or site engineering position; a substantial career-direction shift from Marc's Advanced Diploma.
